title: End of the Alpha
description: Demo-build boundary. Plays once after the Rat King defeat cutscene when demo_mode is on, and nothing story-side chains after it. The player keeps their save and can still explore; what stops is the story queue, so alpha feedback lands on the mission that was actually being tested.

steps.text: The crown sits crooked on the cave floor. Somewhere above, a kingdom is still deciding whether any of this happened.
That is as far as this build goes. The Rat King was the whole of what we asked you to play, and you have played it.
Thank you. Genuinely — you were the first person who wasn't us.

Your save is intact and the world stays open. Wander, grind, break things. Nothing further in the story will start, so anything odd from here is you exploring past the edge of the map, not the game losing its place.
If something felt wrong, felt slow, or felt good — that is the thing we want. Press F1 at any time for the controls.
